Description: Si PIN photodiode, SMD DIL 4.5x4 mm, 7.02 mm2, peak 620 nm, IR-filtered 400-690 nm, tr 90 ns
DigiKey PN / page: SFH 2440, or SFH 2440-Z for tape and reel
Notes: CHANGED 2026-09-21. Was BPW34S. Osram SMD version is discontinued, and Vishay BPW34S is LEADED (doc 81521: "packed in tubes, specifications like BPW34"), so the old line paired an SMD footprint with a through-hole part number. SFH 2440 is pad-identical to Osram_BPW34S-SMD so there is no layout change; peak 620 nm matches the 625 nm emitter, and its 400-690 nm window blocks the IR the BPW34 (peak 900 nm) was most sensitive to. NOT SFH 2430: 200 us rise time, 1000 pF, unusable for tach phase.
